evidence.observation: Exhaust oxygen was 6.2 ppm, near the preceding ramp/growth baseline of approximately 3–6 ppm.
Oxygen increased to 14.8 ppm during unchanged growth setpoints.
Oxygen rose further to 19.4 ppm, indicating a sustained departure from the established low-oxygen atmosphere.
Temperature 750.1 °C and Ar 99.6 sccm track setpoints; heater power 43.5% and pressure 760.8 Torr remain stable despite the oxygen rise; controller reports running.

args.missing_evidence: Independent oxygen verification and gas-supply/leak checks are needed to distinguish air ingress, feed contamination, outgassing, or oxygen-sensor error; sample characterization is not yet available.
